$comment: Allow-list for `bun run audit:data-pribadi`. One entry per false positive, each with a reason. `path` is an exact file, or a directory prefix ending in `/`; `line` (optional) pins one line; `category` is one of national-id, mobile-phone, email, file-share-link, tracked-data-file. An entry that covers no finding fails the gate. Never put the matched value in `reason`.
